title: [MWB][UITests] One type per file; stop suppressing warnings-as-errors (stack 4/4)

proposed_comments.title: Include the startup phase in initialization errors

confidence.rationale: The message omission is directly visible in the exact upstream exception path and the same method records and reports startupStage on timeout; severity remains low because the inner exception still preserves the root cause.

proposed_comments.body:
### Include the startup phase in receiver initialization errors

**Severity:** `low`

`ReceiverController` records `startupStage` before each setup operation and includes it in the timeout error, but this wrapper omits it. Include that phase in the `InvalidOperationException` message while preserving the original exception as `InnerException`; this makes setup failures faster to localize without losing the underlying cause.

```suggestion
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Receiver initialization failed during " + startupStage + ".", error.InnerException);
```

The literal replacement compiled with the Windows PowerShell 5.1 worker `Add-Type` source set; an initialization-failure runtime scenario was not exercised.
